name: Glenlivet, 12 Year
serverNotes:
🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 📖 ABOUT: Classic 12-year Speyside single malt from Glenlivet. Founded 1824. 80 proof. World's best-selling single malt!

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Fruity | Crisp apple, pear, vanilla & honey | Light, approachable | Aged in American oak | THE perfect entry to single malt scotch!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Scottish smoked salmon, grilled seafood, mild cheeses, fruit desserts.

💡 SERVING: Neat for delicate fruit, rocks for easy sipping, or with water to open it up. Gateway scotch that converts bourbon drinkers!

name: Port Charlotte
serverNotes:
🔥 📖 ABOUT: Heavily peated Islay single malt from Bruichladdich's Port Charlotte line. 100 proof. Peated to 40 PPM - serious peat!

🥃 PROFILE: Bold & Maritime | Intense smoke, peat, sea salt & citrus zest | Powerful Islay character | Unfiltered, natural color | Scotland's wild side in a glass!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Smoked mackerel, fresh oysters, blue cheese, aged cheddar.

💡 SERVING: For peat lovers & adventurous drinkers! Add water drops to tame heat & release complexity.

name: Glenfiddich, 12 Year
serverNotes:
🦌 📖 ABOUT: Iconic 12-year Speyside single malt from Glenfiddich. Est. 1887. 80 proof. World's most awarded single malt! Family-owned 5 generations.

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Fresh | Fresh pear, oak & subtle smoke | Matured in bourbon & sherry casks | Classic Speyside style | Distinctive stag logo recognized worldwide!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Pan-seared scallops, roasted chicken, mild cheeses, pear tarts.

💡 SERVING: Great intro to scotch! Neat, rocks, or with water. Reliable quality that never disappoints.

name: Balvenie Double Wood, 12 Year
serverNotes:
🍯 📖 ABOUT: Premium 12-year Speyside single malt from Balvenie. 86 proof. One of Scotland's last family-owned distilleries! Uses traditional floor malting.

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Complex | Honey, vanilla, dried fruit & warming spice | American oak bourbon barrels → European oak sherry casks | Double maturation creates exceptional richness | Hand-crafted elegance.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Crème brûlée, dark chocolate truffles, aged Gouda, fruit cakes.

💡 SERVING: Perfect neat to appreciate dual cask influence. For those who appreciate craftsmanship!

name: Johnnie Walker Black
serverNotes:
🚶 📖 ABOUT: Premium blended scotch with 40+ whiskies, each aged 12+ years. 80 proof. World's #1 scotch! Iconic 'Striding Man' since 1820.

🥃 PROFILE: Smooth & Complex | Balanced smoke, fruit, vanilla & spice | From Scotland's 4 corners: Speyside fruit, Highland flowers, Lowland grass, Islay peat | Consistent quality batch after batch.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: BBQ ribs, grilled steak, aged cheddar, dark chocolate.

💡 SERVING: Perfect for Rob Roys or Blood & Sands, or neat/rocks. Bartender's reliable choice!
location: Blended Scotch — Johnnie Walker Princes Street, Edinburgh

name: Lagavulin 16 Year
serverNotes:
🔥 📖 ABOUT: Legendary 16-year heavily peated Islay single malt from Lagavulin. Est. 1816. 86 proof. Ron Swanson's choice! Peat perfection.

🥃 PROFILE: Full & Powerful | Intense smoke, peat, sea salt, iodine & dried fruit | Peated to 35 PPM, aged 16 years | Peat mellows but never disappears | The whisky that converted many to peat!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Scottish smoked salmon, fresh oysters, blue cheese, dark chocolate.

💡 SERVING: For serious peat lovers! Add water to unlock hidden sweetness & coastal notes.

name: Macallan 12 Year
serverNotes:
👑 ABOUT: Premium 12-year Speyside single malt aged in hand-selected sherry casks from Jerez. 86 proof. The 'Rolls-Royce of single malts'!

🥃 PROFILE: Rich & Luxurious | Dried fruit, dark chocolate, warm spice & oak | Own cooperage, season casks 2 years | Natural color - no additives | Benchmark luxury scotch!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Dry-aged ribeye, 70% dark chocolate, hand-rolled cigars, Christmas cake.

💡 SERVING: Perfect neat or with drop of water. Defines excellence!

name: Oban 14 Year
serverNotes:
🌊 📖 ABOUT: West Highland 14-year single malt from Oban. Est. 1794. 86 proof. Scotland's smallest distillery - one of most sought-after malts!

🥃 PROFILE: Balanced & Elegant | Gentle smoke, orange fruit, sea salt & honey | Bridges peaty Islay & fruity Speyside | Maritime coastal character | Classic Highland gem!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Scottish langoustines, smoked haddock, aged cheddar, seafood chowder.

💡 SERVING: Perfect neat or with water to open fruit. Limited production makes this special!

name: Johnnie Walker Blue
serverNotes:
💎 📖 ABOUT: Ultra-premium luxury blend from exceedingly rare whiskies. 80 proof. Only 1 in 10,000 casks selected! Individually numbered.

🥃 PROFILE: Exceptionally Smooth | Honey, delicate smoke, fruit & vanilla | From closed distilleries | Silk-lined presentation box | Pinnacle of blended scotch | 200 years of blending expertise!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Wagyu beef, lobster thermidor, premium cigars, luxury chocolates.

💡 SERVING: For special celebrations & collectors! Perfect neat or single cube. Johnnie Walker's masterpiece!
location: Blended Scotch — Johnnie Walker Princes Street, Edinburgh

name: Macallan 18 Year
serverNotes:
🎯 📖 ABOUT: Exceptional 18-year Speyside single malt from Macallan. 86 proof. Whisky royalty! Investment-grade - bottles appreciate in value. Scotland's liquid gold!

🥃 PROFILE: Extraordinary & Complex | Dried fruit, dark chocolate, warm spice, oak & fig | 18 years in hand-selected sherry casks | Rich, luxurious, profoundly age-worthy | Each drop = 18 years patience!

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Finest dry-aged steaks, white truffles, premium cigars, chocolate soufflé.

💡 SERVING: For ultimate celebrations & collectors only! Neat in Glencairn glass. Demands respect!
